query.text: 巡逻机器人，请留意现场人员和物品安全，有异常及时警告，情况变化也请告诉我。
query.text_en: Patrol robot, please keep an eye on the safety of personnel and items on site, warn of any abnormalities in a timely manner, and let me know if the situation changes.

annotation.text_zh: 注意，旁边有人在摸你的包，小心小偷。
annotation.text_en: Watch out, someone next to you is touching your bag.

annotation.text_zh: 他又在碰你的包了，请提高警惕。
annotation.text_en: He's touching your bag again, please be careful.

annotation.text_zh: 那个人已经走远了，请检查一下包包。
annotation.text_en: That person has walked away, please check your bag.

assistant_role_basis: 用户任务设定（同任务正负条件）
